title: Construct an inequivalent one-edge binary maximizer
body:
## Summary

This scoped construction gives a second complete binary projector pool with pattern dimension `k=3`, matching number `ν=1` and irreducible joint-image dimension `n=4`. Two unordered pairs of its projectors have a trace-one product. Four pairs do in the published maximizer. The trace count is preserved by simultaneous conjugation, so the two actions are inequivalent even after relabelling the projectors.

The new construction was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit aliromman for the even maximum and comparison pool in [#7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707) and the matching theorem in [#7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692). [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19718509).

## Evidence

The written proof finds the complete pool by its two cross rectangles and shows irreducibility by a directed walk through the four basis images. Both verifier modes scan all 120 rank-one idempotents at width four and find four lifts in the seven nonzero patterns. All 15 nonzero starting vectors reach all four basis images. Both modes print `PASS_EVEN_ONE_EDGE_MAXIMIZER` and took 0.01 seconds each locally.

Run from the repository root with CPython 3.12.15 and its standard library. Local verification ran on macOS arm64.

```sh
python3.12 -B research/even-one-edge-maximizer/verify.py
python3.12 -B -O research/even-one-edge-maximizer/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/even-one-edge-maximizer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/even-one-edge-maximizer --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The upper bound is cited from the pinned matching result. The verifier checks the new witness. Predecessor replays, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The native word, dirty-state restoration and recursive invoice remain open.

## Open next questions

- Classify the actions at `(3,1,4)`. Enumerate complete pools containing a fixed unit at width four before considering wider embeddings.
- Look for a rank-saving paid word in the new alphabet. Specify the saturated exponent lattice and the full ambient endpoint first.

## Related open work

- [#7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707) attains the same maximum of four. This package supplies an inequivalent attaining action.
- [#7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692) gives the matching-dependent upper bound used here.
- [#7703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7703) classifies the strict equality case on the odd side of the matching bound.
- [#7693](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7693) classifies actions at the unrestricted maximum `n=2k−1`. At `k=3`, its maximum uses two edges.
- [#7710](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7710) studies paid words on the prescribed orthogonal fresh-bridge family, which includes the comparison alphabet. The changed old factors of the new links fall outside that family.
- [#7711](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7711) gives a four-relation word obstruction on #7707’s six-projector `(4,0,5)` maximizer. The new alphabet has four projectors.
- [#7742](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7742) studies a single pass through that six-projector alphabet. The new result stops at the geometry of the four-projector alphabet.

## CI notes

This PR carries the shared CI-doc and replay-gap sync used by other open PRs.

The six local current-status tests and the registered historical replay-gap check passed with CPython 3.12.15. All three hosted jobs passed at `6bd8a384d64b6da2334bc94f6a97cdd74d710780`. The jobs were `plan` and the registered replays for `research/even-one-edge-maximizer` and `research/historical-selected-replay-gap`. [Run 44400399401](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44400399401)

Before the sync, the canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` failed `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` locally because the CI guide names `make frontier6030-verify` while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The same planning failure skipped hosted replay on [#7740](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44396331232/job/135127124652) and [#7711](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44334152015/job/134906164982).

## Merge danger

Two-way. The construction adds five files under `research/even-one-edge-maximizer/`. The CI sync is a separate commit.
